name: Joe Smallze Memorial Cup
epitaph: A cup FAW gave in memory of Joe “Soulja” Smallze, who wrestled here and died in April 2002. One holder survives in the record: Tony Vigilante, introduced on the 10 August 2003 Panic as “the Joe Smallze 2003 memorial cup holder”. Nothing else in the surviving record describes how it was contested or who else ever held it. It is the second thing FAW named for him — the fed retired its Television Championship unfilled in his name the year before.

bestowals.source: FAW's own Panic recap of 10 August 2003 (promotions/faw/archive/panic-2003-08-10.html) — the ring announcer's own introduction: “he is the Joe Smallze 2003 memorial cup holder and number one contender to the FAW World Heavyweight Championship... Mr. Tony Vigilante!!!” A second source, nine days earlier: FAW’s own Panic preview of 1 August 2003, carried on eWNews (promotions/ew-news-2002/news/panic-preview-08-03-2003-2003-08-01.html), names the runner-up — Spawn, “more than displeased since losing the Joe Smallze Memorial Cup to Tony Vigilante in the Final.”
